items.title: Submit ID copy and self-disclosure form (AML update)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Unterlagen binnen 8 Werktagen (Montag bis Samstag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens ein.
items.computation: The letter is dated Thursday 18.12.2025 and sets the period as 8 Werktage (Mon–Sat, excluding public holidays) 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens', i.e. starting from the letter's own date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (18.12.2025) is not counted, so counting starts 19.12.2025. Counting 8 working days (Mon–Sat, skipping Sundays and public holidays) from there lands on Tuesday 30.12.2025 (25.12. and 26.12.2025 are public holidays in NW and are skipped). 30.12.2025 is itself a working day, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The letter warns that the securities account ('Depot') will be blocked for purchases if the documents are not submitted in time, so treat the 30.12.2025 deadline as important.

Several details in this letter (bank name 'Muster Bank AG', address 'Musterfurt', e-mail domain 'muster-bank.example') look like generic placeholder/template values rather than a real institution's data; verify the sender's genuine contact details before sending a copy of your ID and personal data anywhere.

Before mailing your ID and self-disclosure form, confirm through a channel you already trust (e.g. the number on your bank card or an existing statement) that this request is genuinely from your bank, since ID/document requests are a common phishing pattern.
